text:
jamie: quick proposal — schedule a micro-canary tonight for the tenant-split terraform apply (IAM role rename + provider bump). target quiet window 23:00-23:30 PST. can we do a staged shard so only 2% of tenants get the IAM change first?
lucas: +1 for micro-canary. what exact resources are changing? any cross-account roles?
jamie: minimal set: module/iam/roles.tf -> rename app-exec -> app-exec-v2, attach new assume_role policy. provider upgrade: hashicorp/aws 4.60 -> 4.80 (pin in root module). no cross-account changes in this wave.
sai: pinging deploybot to request a hold signal during the canary. if any errors we want an automatic hold and a manual rollback checklist.
deploybot: [bot] scheduled apply queued by @jamie for 2026-03-20T23:00:00-08:00 (thread 1876543210). preflight plan step will run at T-20m. will emit :warning: if drift or unknown resources detected.
anya: suggest we add a soft-fail escape hatch: if IAM attach failures > 0 or any assume_role errors in cloudtrail, deploybot should stop rollout and mark canary failed. then we revert the role rename only (keep provider pin).
lucas: sounds good. also add provider-override to canary workspace: set provider_installation to "local" and provider_versions = {
  aws = "~> 4.80"
} to avoid autoswitch during canary.
jamie: plan snippet (sanitized):
```
# Terraform will perform the following actions:
  - resource "aws_iam_role" "app_exec" {
      - name: "app-exec" -> "app-exec-v2"
    }
  + resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "new_assume" {
      + role = "app-exec-v2"
    }
```
sai: FYI I ran `terraform plan -var-file=canary.tfvars -target=module.iam` in staging. no diffs other than rename/attachment. logs: "Plan: 1 to add, 1 to change, 1 to destroy."
ops-bot: [bot] preflight checks OK: tffmt OK, linters pass, state lock available. however provider checksum mismatch found locally vs registry -> recommend pining checksum in mirror.
jamie: noted — will pin checksum and push small commit. that commit will be excluded from canary apply (we'll apply the pin after successful canary). reason: we want provider behavior consistent but not risk unknown checksum change mid-run.
lucas: what are rollback steps if canary fails on assume_role? manual steps OK but doc them here.
anya: rollback checklist (short):
1) pause deploybot (signal HOLD)
2) run `terraform workspace select canary && terraform state rm aws_iam_role.app_exec` to remove half-applied resource if needed
3) apply patch to revert role name to "app-exec"
4) run smoke tests for auth flows for affected tenants
5) escalate to infra-oncall if > 5 tenants impacted
sai: add automation note: deploybot should auto-hold on any CloudTrail "AccessDenied" logs flagged during assume_role for the canary tenant IDs. ops-bot can watch cloudtrail and emit a hold tag.
deploybot: [bot] configured auto-hold trigger: cloudtrail.assume_role.errors > 0 for tenant set canary-001..canary-020 -> will post HOLD and cancel remaining shards. manual override required to continue.
jamie: timeline: 22:40 preflight runs, 22:50 final signoff, 23:00 micro-canary apply (2% tenants), 23:05 smoke run, 23:10 decision window. if green, we roll to 25% at 23:20, then full rollout 00:00.
lucas: please add release notes snippet for support: "IAM role rename app-exec -> app-exec-v2; provider pinned for stability during rollout." also note the rollback playbook link: https://internal.redwood/infra/playbooks/iam-rollback
anya: one more safety: do not run the apply during backup window (we're OK) and set deploybot throttle to 1 apply/min to avoid surges.
sai: I'm standing by for the preflight logs, I'll run the smoke tests once canary executes.
ops-bot: [bot] deploybot hold policy set: rate_limit=1/min, shard_size=2%, auto_hold_on_cloudtrail=true.
jamie: thanks team — I'll push the canary plan commit now and call signoff at 22:55. please react with :thumbsup: if you see any issues.
lucas: :thumbsup:
sai: :thumbsup:
anya: :thumbsup:
deploybot: [bot] preflight started at 2026-03-20T22:40:00-08:00 for thread 1876543210. running terraform plan (canary workspace)...
ops-bot: [bot] preflight result: PLAN_OK. no unexpected resource drifts. scheduled apply will proceed at 2026-03-20T23:00:00-08:00 unless a HOLD is posted.
jamie: last check — log retention for canary logs set to 90 days? we want longer for audit.
sai: I'll mirror logs to ops-s3/canary-1876543210 for 180 days after run.
anya: good. closing thread for now, we'll reopen if deploybot posts HOLD or FAIL. good luck. :rocket:
